purpose: Numerical illustration of the theorem; not a held-out evaluation.

model.initialization: zero coefficients and fixed zero intercept
model.risk: conditional excess half squared loss given rare presence

search.alpha_grid: zero and 4097 geometric points from 1e-6 to 2
search.coarse_alpha_grid: zero and every second positive fine-grid point
search.stops: every integer from zero through the observation cap
search.selection: population rare risk, averaged over training randomness
